scientific_integrity: Squarefreeness follows locally modulo any repeated prime. Parity isolates the solution N=2 on the even branch and forces odd M at odd N. The support bound is an exact rational extremum over the first fifteen odd primes; the finite scan is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: No existence is proved for the branch with at least sixteen distinct prime factors. The elementary extremal-product method ceases to exclude the next support size because the product over the first sixteen odd primes exceeds three.
title: A sixteen-prime support barrier for the minus Dedekind–Lehmer equation
